title: Diagram pointer: tasks[id].diagram in GET /api/v1/state and the head of GET /api/v1/diagram/:task
description: Derived at read time from the side store (<data>/diagrams.ndjson) and the journal's feedback; never journaled, never in state.json or rows/*.json, never written by cos-board push. Absent on a task with no attached diagram (none, archived, or created for an earlier task with the same id): the Diagram tab then draws the architecture graph as today. unreviewed is the replan gate (D7a): the task's feedback of kind diagram with no received; the dispatcher refuses the next dispatch while unreviewed_count is above 0. unreviewed lists the first 50 ids only.

sha256.description: Blob address of the current revision; also the ETag base of the GET view.

owner_at.description: Time of the latest owner act on this diagram (owner revision, pin, unpin, accept). Display only.

owner_seq.description: journal_seq of the latest owner act on this diagram (absent: the create line's journal_seq). fb evidence must be fb-N with N > owner_seq (contract 3.3).

pinned.description: null = agent draft; set = the owner's source of truth since rev. Only an owner UI line sets or clears it.

coord_removed.description: The removal window (contract 3.4, gate MF-A): node and edge ids removed in the last 24 h by every write made without an owner device (coordinator, Basic login, un-stepped device/ui token, a bound-ask accept not answered from an owner device), since the latest owner-device line. A write without an owner device that would take nodes above 10 or edges above 20 is refused: owner 403 owner_device_required (503 owner_2fa_off while 2FA is off), coordinator 409 needs_owner_act. The field keeps its rev-2 name.

stale.description: Nodes whose VI and EN are out of sync (viAt != enAt or syncSha mismatch).

unreviewed.description: The first 50 unreviewed ids, oldest first.
